apps.name: MindSpace
apps.subtitle: Private meditation, quietly focused
apps.versionDescription: MindSpace 3.0.0 introduces a calm, image-free iOS interface with clearer daily practice, course progress, playback, completion, accessibility, and private-content states while preserving existing data and behavior.
apps.localizedDescription: MindSpace is a private, account-free meditation app with 275+ hours of audio and video courses, authenticated private GitHub streaming, selective downloads, offline playback, progress, reminders, and portable backups.

versions.localizedDescription: Quiet Native redesign with an image-free visual system, clearer Today-to-completion flow, accessible controls and adaptive layouts, a non-celestial app icon, and preserved playback, downloads, progress, credentials, and backups.

Photorealistic AI Celestial Artworks, On-Demand Private GitHub Streaming & Singles Downloads: Fresh photorealistic 3D planet bodies with 100% native RGBA alpha transparency, serene deep-space App Icon render, seamless AVURLAsset online streaming from private GitHub repository, and category-level Singles downloads.

Cinematic Hybrid Celestial Visuals & Polished App Icon: Upgraded all 9 celestial planets with transparent alpha blending, atmospheric glowing coronas, mindful breathing physics, and polished iOS App Icon with deep cosmic lighting.

Private GitHub Content Sync & Selective Downloads: Integrated hardware-backed KeychainManager for PAT credentials, on-demand course downloading directly from private GitHub repositories with live progress and SHA-256 verification, Goal-Oriented Smart Sync, and new Library 'Available' filter.
Curated sleep sounds, zero battery drain optimizations, DateFormatterCache, and Vercel OTA sync.
MindSpace 2.0.0 Release with full offline catalog
